title: Family Member Testifies in Trial of Caleb Flynn
summary: Kayla Keyt testified in the trial of Caleb Flynn, providing details about her family's business and the defendant. The trial is ongoing.
title_hi: कैलेब फ्लिन के मुकदमे में परिवार की सदस्य ने गवाही दी
